Their right hand holds a thin brown wooden branch. [Objects: Branch] The branch is held steady initially as a tan and white Corgi stares up with an excited facial expression and mouth open. [Setting: Park] The background is a flat green lawn with natural daylight. (2) [People: Arm/Tattoo] The person moves their right forearm, which features a multi-colored tattoo of a dog and text, waving the branch rapidly. [Objects: Branch] The branch swishes back and forth like a toy. [Setting: Park] A second Corgi briefly enters the frame in the middle distance, also watching the movement. (3) [People: Hands] The person uses their left hand to briefly pet the first Corgi's head while continuing to manipulate the branch with the other hand. [Objects: Branch] The stick is bobbed up and down mimicking a cat teaser. [Setting: Park] The background shows a metal fence and distant trees under an overcast but bright sky. (4) [People: Hands] The person lowers the branch toward the ground, allowing the dog to sniff it closely. [Objects: Branch] The branch comes to rest on the grass. [Setting: Park] The camera captures close-up details of the green grass and small dry leaves scattered on the ground as the dog pants happily.
